content_zh:
短剑随意插在身侧的地上，顾青山缠着绷带，靠着墙，席地而坐。
他的面色有些沉重。
头脑时不时陷入空白状态。
记忆之中的许多东西，他努力去想，但一片模糊。
那个叫赵六的士兵端来一锅汤水，架在火上，盖好了锅盖。
赵六又摸出来一个小巧的盒子递给顾青山，说道：“多亏了你，不然我也会死在那怪物手上。”
“这是什么？”顾青山接过盒子，问道。
赵六道：“营地仅剩的两粒疗伤丹药。”
顾青山问：“你怎么不自己留着用？”
赵六摇头道：“我不是修行者，用不了这个。”
顾青山顾青山就取出一枚，放在手里细细查看。
丹药品相完好，连表面包裹的一层薄薄封蜡都没有丝毫脱落。
淡绿色的丹药散发出幽幽清香，让人闻之精神一振。
这就是疗伤丹了。
疗伤丹是最低级的加血药，放在过去顾青山看都不会看一眼，可现在重生而来，往日修为化为乌有，一身上下伤痕累累，这两枚疗伤丹却是无价之宝。
顾青山不禁问道：“整个军营，只剩下这两枚疗伤丹药了？”
赵六叹了口气，道：“是啊，人死光后，补给路线被切断，不止是丹药，其他各种物资也都所剩无几。”
顾青山默然片刻，忽想起一事：“军营里还有灵石吗？”
赵六道：“没有了。”
“那可糟糕了。”顾青山叹气道。

赵六赶忙问道：“怎么？”
顾青山道：“营地的隐匿法阵已经很虚弱，没有灵石补充的话，法阵很快就会消失。”
赵六打了个寒战，爬起来，疯狂的冲了出去。
隐匿法阵若是停了，妖魔立刻就能发现这一处军营，到时候绝对是十死无生。
难怪前几日那两名校尉临走时，眼神中带着那种全然的绝望。
顾青山看着他冲出去，又等了十数息的工夫，外面传来轻轻的一声嗡鸣。
这一声响过，代表法阵填装了新的灵石，重新启动。
直到听见这声音，顾青山才略微松了口气。
赵六果然私藏了灵石。
这个世界里，每一个人都是真实的、有血有肉的，如果把他们当成毫无智慧的NPC，那是会吃大亏的。
很久之前，顾青山就懂得了这个道理。
不一会儿，赵六拖着沉重的步伐回来，靠着墙壁慢慢坐下，捂着脸哭了起来。
顾青山道：“哭什么？”
赵六道：“这回灵石真的用完了，等到法阵下一次失灵，我们都会被妖魔杀掉。”
顾青山默然片刻，捏开丹药上的封蜡，一口吞下疗伤丹，开始尝试着感应体内灵力。
起初他还有些忐忑，不知道是否能感应到灵力。
没想到一切都很顺利，丹田内的灵力立刻就响应了他的召唤，配合他将药力化开，搬运到体内各处。
顾青山只觉得浑身暖洋洋，各处创口也出现了阵阵麻痒。
伤口已经开始愈合。
等到药力消耗殆尽，顾青山再次睁开眼睛的时候，已经是后半夜了。

顾青山站起来活动了一下，发觉身体好多了，许多创口都结了新痂。
赵六还守在一旁，困得脑袋一点一点的，见顾青山醒了，眼巴巴的问道：“怎么样，你身体可好些了？能不能带我一起逃？”
最后一句话算是说出了他的心声，若不是为了这一点，恐怕疗伤丹都不会拿出来。
顾青山如实说道：“是好些了，但想要完全恢复战斗力，恐怕还得几天。”
“那你休息吧。”
赵六失望的站起来，转身出去了。
赵六走后，顾青山独自坐在地上，陷入沉思。
在他原本所在的年代，游戏中的妖魔早就进入现实世界，毁灭了人类的文明秩序。
残余的人类只能苟延残喘着，眼睁睁等待末日降临。
一切都走到了尽头。
现在想起来，其实早在游戏降临之时，已经有了许多诡异的苗头。
当时现实世界中的各个国家，都纷纷拼了命似的宣传游戏。
粮食、金钱、美色、权势，统统都给你，只要你在游戏里足够强大。
世界各地也出现了许多奇异的事情，但这些事情都被人类高层给捂住了，普通人毫不知情。
直到第一把兵器被人从游戏里带进现实世界，那些平凡的人们才发现，这并不是游戏，而是一个完整的异世界。
所有人都疯狂的投入到游戏中。
但是游戏中的妖魔实在是恐怖，几乎让人绝望。

content_en:
The dagger was casually stuck on the ground beside him. Gu Qingshan was wrapped in a bandage and sitting on the ground against the wall.
His face looked a little heavy.
The mind goes blank from time to time.
He tried hard to think of many things in his memory, but they were all blurry.
The soldier named Zhao Liu brought a pot of soup and water, put it on the fire, and closed the lid.
Zhao Liu took out another small box and handed it to Gu Qingshan, saying, "Thanks to you, otherwise I would have died at the hands of that monster."
"What is this?" Gu Qingshan took the box and asked.
Zhao Liudao: "There are only two healing pills left in the camp."
Gu Qingshan asked: "Why don't you keep it for yourself?"
Zhao Liu shook his head and said, "I'm not a practitioner, so I can't use this."
Gu Qingshan Gu Qingshan took out one, put it in his hand and looked at it carefully.
The elixir is in perfect condition, and even the thin layer of sealing wax covering the surface has not peeled off at all.
The light green elixir exudes a faint fragrance, which makes people feel refreshed.
This is the healing pill.
Healing pills are the lowest blood-increasing medicine. In the past, Gu Qingshan would not have even looked at them. But now that he has been reborn, his past cultivation has been reduced to nothing, and his body is covered with scars. However, these two healing pills are priceless treasures.
Gu Qingshan couldn't help but ask: "Are these two healing pills the only ones left in the entire military camp?"
Zhao Liu sighed and said: "Yes, after all the people died, the supply route was cut off. Not only the pills, but also all other materials were left."
Gu Qingshan was silent for a moment, then suddenly remembered something: "Are there any spirit stones in the military camp?"
Zhao Liudao: "No more."
"That's terrible." Gu Qingshan sighed.
Zhao Liu quickly asked: "What?"
Gu Qingshan said: "The hidden magic circle in the camp is already very weak. Without the supplement of spiritual stones, the magic circle will disappear soon."
Zhao Liu shuddered, got up, and rushed out crazily.
If the concealment circle is stopped, the demon will immediately discover this military camp, and it will definitely be a dead end.
No wonder the two captains had such complete despair in their eyes when they left a few days ago.
Gu Qingshan watched him rush out, and after waiting for another ten breaths, a gentle buzzing came from outside.
This sound means that the magic circle has been filled with new spiritual stones and restarted.
It wasn't until he heard this voice that Gu Qingshan relaxed slightly.
Zhao Liu indeed hid the spirit stone secretly.
In this world, everyone is real and flesh-and-blood. If you treat them as NPCs without intelligence, you will suffer a big loss.
Gu Qingshan understood this truth a long time ago.
After a while, Zhao Liu came back with heavy steps, slowly sat down against the wall, covered his face and cried.
Gu Qingshan said: "Why are you crying?"
Zhao Liudao: "The spirit stones are really used up this time. When the magic circle fails next time, we will all be killed by demons."
Gu Qingshan was silent for a moment, pinched open the sealing wax on the elixir, swallowed the healing elixir in one gulp, and began to try to sense the spiritual power in his body.
At first, he was a little nervous, not knowing whether he could sense spiritual power.
Unexpectedly, everything went smoothly. The spiritual power in the Dantian immediately responded to his call and cooperated with him to dissolve the medicinal power and transport it to various parts of the body.
Gu Qingshan only felt warm all over, and there were bursts of itching in various wounds.
The wound has begun to heal.
When the medicine was exhausted and Gu Qingshan opened his eyes again, it was already late at night.
Gu Qingshan stood up and moved around, and found that his body was much better, and many wounds had new scabs.
Zhao Liu was still standing by, his head was getting sleepy little by little. When he saw Gu Qingshan woke up, he asked eagerly: "How is it? Are you feeling better? Can you take me to escape with you?"
The last sentence expressed his true feelings. If it weren't for this, I'm afraid he wouldn't even have taken out the healing pill.
Gu Qingshan said truthfully: "It's getting better, but if you want to fully restore your combat effectiveness, I'm afraid you have toa few days. "
"Then you rest. "
Zhao Liu stood up in disappointment, turned around and went out.
After Zhao Liu left, Gu Qingshan sat on the ground alone, lost in thought.
In his original era, the monsters in the game had long entered the real world and destroyed the order of human civilization.
The remaining human beings can only linger and wait for the end to come.
Everything has come to an end.
Thinking about it now, in fact, there were already many weird signs as early as the arrival of the game.
At that time, every country in the real world was trying their best to promote the game.
Food, money, beauty, and power are all given to you, as long as you are strong enough in the game.
Many strange things have happened all over the world, but these things have been covered up by high-level human beings, and ordinary people have no idea.
It wasn't until the first weapon was brought from the game into the real world that ordinary people discovered that this was not a game, but a complete different world.
Everyone is crazy into the game.
But the monsters in the game are really terrifying, almost despairing.
